claims: Paul Thomas Anderson won the Best Director Oscar for the film One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson's win for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards was his first win in this category.
One Battle After Another stars Leonardo DiCaprio.
One Battle After Another won the Best Picture award at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won the Best Adapted Screenplay award at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler was nominated for Best Director at the 2026 Oscars for Sinners.
Josh Safdie was nominated for Best Director at the 2026 Oscars for Marty Supreme.
Chloé Zhao was nominated for Best Director at the 2026 Oscars for Hamnet.
Joachim Trier was nominated for Best Director at the 2026 Oscars for Sentimental Value.
Paul Thomas Anderson had victories at the Directors Guild of America awards before his Best Director Oscar win at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson had victories at the BAFTA awards before his Best Director Oscar win at the 98th Academy Awards.
